code:
Integer:
  SQL Server INT/BIGINT | Oracle NUMBER(38)
  MySQL INT/BIGINT       | PostgreSQL INTEGER/BIGINT

Decimal (close to mechanical):
  DECIMAL(p,s) | NUMBER(p,s)
  DECIMAL(p,s) | NUMERIC(p,s)

String:
  VARCHAR/NVARCHAR | VARCHAR2/NVARCHAR2
  VARCHAR          | VARCHAR/TEXT
caption: Oracle has one general-purpose NUMBER type instead of sized integers.

code:
SQL Server DATETIME2
  -> PostgreSQL TIMESTAMP
  -> MySQL DATETIME
  -> Oracle DATE (has seconds!) or TIMESTAMP
     (for fractional seconds)

MySQL DATETIME: fixed value, no time zone
MySQL TIMESTAMP: auto-converts to/from UTC
caption: Oracle's plain DATE type already includes time to the second.
